WITH account_shares AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) AS share
    FROM `order`
    GROUP BY account_id
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM account_shares
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
       AVG(account_shares.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(account_shares.share - average_share.avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM account_shares
CROSS JOIN average_share
WHERE account_shares.share > average_share.avg_share;
